notes: Three taḥwīl routes; each is written in full with shared_tail null because the two branches that stop at معاذ بن هشام do not write the names after him, and the father in the middle route (أبي) may be the same man as هشام but is not merged (rule 9)
«وهو ابن الحارث» is not in this report; the gloss «واللفظ لعبيد الله بن سعيد» is left out
«أن زينب ... حدثته» and «أن أم سلمة حدثتها» are rule 5: the saying is Umm Salama's report; she is the last link
